purpose: Original bright hand-painted cartoon game art, guided by visual analysis of user-provided Pocket Mine screenshots. No original game image files are used in runtime.

assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one production-ready original game character sprite, transparent PNG, square image. A charming chibi BLOCKY MINER adventurer for a bright 2D casual mobile mining game. Entire body and pickaxe visible, fills about 85 percent of image height. Three-quarter front view facing slightly right, cheerful determined face, square head inspired by voxel game shapes but drawn as a polished hand-painted cartoon. Bright orange-yellow safety helmet with a tiny white headlamp, vivid cyan turquoise short-sleeve shirt, deep cobalt blue trousers, warm tan leather boots and gloves, small brown backpack. Holds an oversized silver and golden wooden pickaxe raised in a lively ready-to-mine pose. Big clear expressive face, two dark eyes, appealing small stocky proportions. Crisp deep ink outline, clean faceted cel shading, white highlights, fresh saturated colors. Match a professional playful colorful mobile mining game's bright gold / turquoise / silver sprite art. Absolutely no muted muddy haze, no photorealism, no low-poly 3D render. Transparent background; no floor, no scenery, no cast shadow under feet, no text, no UI, no other characters. Keep every part fully inside frame, do not crop pickaxe or helmet.
